title: Founded ByteDance in 2012 and built Toutiao and Douyin/TikTok
statement: Founded ByteDance in 2012 and built Toutiao and Douyin/TikTok.

title: Stepped down as CEO of ByteDance on November 4
statement: Stepped down as CEO of ByteDance on November 4, 2021, completing a handover announced in May 2021, while remaining chairman.
outcome: Zhang retained the chairman title and majority voting control of ByteDance after the CEO handover, and TikTok's continued global growth made him the richest person in China by 2024, per Wikipedia's citation of Bloomberg data.
